search-0012b0aec66e5a250ab438c5e8a93ef9c.example: All six legs are attached to the thorax.

search-005bc5c2e3eda888e9710622372ad53dd.example: The recovery vehicle will lift the car, so I do not need to empty the boot.

search-008231aaf99956982ffbb132c5fe9d792.definition: How a person presents their gender through clothes, voice, gesture and behaviour.
search-008231aaf99956982ffbb132c5fe9d792.example: His gender expression changed when he started a new job, and the fit got easier.

search-00a9e4255a5b63067b76cbfb9fd67f26b.definition: A warm way to say what you want. It is like saying I want, but kinder.

search-00a9e4255a5b63067b76cbfb9fd67f26b.definition: A measure of liquid. There are 1000 millilitres in one litre.
search-00a9e4255a5b63067b76cbfb9fd67f26b.example: I drink one litre of milk every week.

search-00a9e4255a5b63067b76cbfb9fd67f26b.definition: The upward push that the wings make on a plane. It is what holds the plane in the air.
search-00a9e4255a5b63067b76cbfb9fd67f26b.example: More speed means more lift on the wings.

search-00a9e4255a5b63067b76cbfb9fd67f26b.definition: Saying something you know is not true, on purpose, to make things easier for yourself.

search-00a9e4255a5b63067b76cbfb9fd67f26b.example: It was really nice meeting you — see you around.

search-00e13ed7af55b27622f1d6eab5bec0147.definition: Professional or learning activity performed in a distraction-free state that pushes cognitive ability to its limit.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A small amount of food that you eat between two meals.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: I brought a snack to school for break time.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The firm stem that holds leaves up. Broccoli and bok choy grow on one.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: I eat the stalk of the broccoli too.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: To cook small pieces of food quickly in a little oil over a hot fire.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: We stir-fry the morning glory for five minutes.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The bowl in the bathroom where water comes out. You wash your hands and face in it.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: My hands are under the sink tap.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The bar or liquid that makes bubbles. Bubbles carry the dirt away with the water.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: There is a new bar of soap by the sink.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A flat board on the wall where you keep books and other things.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: There are six books on the shelf.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A shape with four equal sides and four corners. A cracker is a square.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The floor tile is a square.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The stalk of the plant. It holds the leaves up and carries water and food.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The stem was thicker this year than last year.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A ball of hot gas that makes its own light. The Sun is a star.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: That bright dot is a star, shining all by itself.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A smell that hangs in the air. Dogs can smell scents and follow them a long way.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Pip knew the scent of his own garden.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A dark shape that appears when something blocks the light.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The old tree made a long shadow on the path.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The compulsory payment into the social insurance system that covers sickness, maternity, accidents and retirement.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: My social insurance contribution is a percentage of my gross pay.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A relationship that has no agreed label. Nobody has said what it is, and nobody has asked.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: We have been seeing each other for months and calling it a situationship.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: When one person's behaviour and words point in different directions, usually because they are unsure or unwilling to say where things stand.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: He texts every day but has cancelled three plans — those are mixed signals.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: Giving the other side's position its strongest and most honest form before you argue against it.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Before you answer, steelman the other view in one sentence and see if it still convinces you.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: Short, friendly conversation with someone you do not know well. Its purpose is contact, not important information.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: We had some small talk about the rain and ended up talking for an hour.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The length of time you can hold focus on one task. It depends on the task and on your state, not on a fixed personal rating.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: My attention span on a spreadsheet is fine; it is the phone that breaks it.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: Phishing carried out by text message. Short, urgent, and arriving on the phone you are holding.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The message about a parcel was smishing, and the link was not the courier's website.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: Presenting a false sender identity so that a call or a message appears to come from a number or address that belongs to someone else.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The message showed my brother's name, but the number was spoofed.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: Free storage of bags before check-in or after check-out, which lets you use the city without carrying a suitcase.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Could you store my luggage until my flight in the evening?

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The closing line of an email, such as "Kind regards", followed by your name.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Use a plain sign-off: Kind regards, then your name and title.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: How steep the line is; the coefficient of x.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: A horizontal line has slope zero.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A paid workspace where people work in the same room, usually by the day or the month, with a desk and reliable internet.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: A co-working space costs less than the coffee I would buy sitting in a café all day.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: Staying in one place for weeks or months instead of moving on every few days, which is what makes long-term work possible.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Slow travel costs less and lets you actually know the place.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The disorientation you feel when the everyday rules of a place stop matching the ones you grew up with.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Culture shock hit me the week I could not find a supermarket open after six.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A rule everybody follows without discussing it, such as removing shoes before entering a home.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The norm here is to arrive ten minutes late, and everyone reads the time differently.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: Being alone by choice, with no element of loss or distress. It is not the same as loneliness.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Two hours of solitude on Sunday is what makes the week work.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The value a person draws from their relationships, and the trust that makes working together easier.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: A good boss spends a lot of the budget on building social capital.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The ABS has a fault. Normal braking still works, but the wheels can lock under heavy braking. Severity level 3 — Warning. Action: Have the ABS checked. Until then, brake earlier and more gently..
A small part at each wheel that reports how fast that wheel is turning.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: A damaged sensor at one wheel can switch the ABS off.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A small part at each wheel that reports how fast that wheel is turning.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: A damaged sensor at one wheel can switch the ABS off.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The material under the tyre: tarmac, concrete, gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice or leaves.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The road surface was loose gravel, so a locked wheel was the shorter stop.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: Coarse salt that softens the water in a dishwasher so that detergent can work. It goes in the round cap at the bottom of the tub.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The salt symbol has come on, so I am filling the salt cap.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The last stage of a wash, in which the drum turns fast to push water out of the fabric.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: A higher spin speed means the washing comes out drier.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A pump whose motor is sealed in a case that works under water.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: A submersible pump hangs on a cable inside the well.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A pit that collects water from a floor or a basement so that a pump can lift it.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The sump in the basement pit fills when the floor drain backs up.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A switch on a float that starts or stops the pump when the water level rises or falls.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The float switch in the tank stops the pump when the tank is empty.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A valve on the tank that opens and releases water if the pressure or the temperature inside becomes too high.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The safety valve is the small brass valve on the cold pipe.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A burn caused by hot liquid or steam.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Water at 60 °C can scald a child in a few seconds.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: Any effect the medicine has other than the one it is meant to produce.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Nausea is listed as a side effect, and it usually passes after the first few days.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: Something you notice and describe yourself: pain, dizziness, a cough, a lump.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The main symptom is the pain, and it has been there for three weeks.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A written symbol such as = or +.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The equals sign balances both sides.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A small sense organ on a robot. It tells the robot what is around it, or how it feels.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Bit's sensor flashed red when he was worried.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The sun is shining and there are few clouds. A sunny day is a happy day.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: It is sunny, so we can play outside.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: Letting somebody use your things, and letting them do things with you too.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: We shared the ball all afternoon.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A small mistake that happens because you were busy or in a hurry.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: That was just a slip.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: To cut something into thin, flat pieces.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: I slice the banana and put it on top.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A top with a collar that you wear over your body, on its own or under a jacket.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: My school shirt has a blue collar.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: Soft cloth you wear on your feet, inside your shoes.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: These socks are too big for me.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: Hard things you wear on your feet. One is for the left foot and one for the right.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: I put on my shoes by the door.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A small bowl with a handle. We use it for soup, rice and porridge.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Can I have a spoon for my soup?

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: One of the ways your body finds out about the world. You have five main ones.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Smell is a sense that helps you find food.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The light that comes from the Sun. It looks white, but it holds all the colours of the rainbow.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Sunlight is white until rain or mist splits it into colours.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: When light bounces off tiny bits in the air and spreads out in all directions.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Scattering is the reason the whole sky is blue.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A baby plant that has just come out of the soil. Very small, very green.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: A green sprout appeared above the soil.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The soft earth where plants grow. It holds water and food for the roots.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The seed fell into the soft brown soil.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The total of all the digits of a number, used to test whether it is a multiple of 9.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The digit sum of 1296 is 1 + 2 + 9 + 6 = 18, a multiple of 9.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A setup in which several specialized AI agents divide a task among themselves and pass work along.
Reasoning about how the parts of a system affect each other, including effects that appear far away in time or structure.
Concluding what illness one has without a medical examination, usually from online information.
A medical source written or reviewed by qualified professionals, updated, and not selling the fear it describes.
The false feeling of competence that comes from producing results with powerful tools rather than from owned ability.
The weakening of a skill through long disuse, often because a tool has performed it instead.
The proportion of useful information (signal) to everything else (noise) in a stream of content.
Familiarity with the surface of many topics without understanding of how any of them works.
Holding a decision back for a short time so that the second argument can be made.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: A little self-control before the reply is cheaper than a retraction later.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: Judging your own work or your own ability.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Self-assessment told him he was ready; the job in front of him said otherwise.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The ability to handle shapes, positions and how parts fit together.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Spatial reasoning is what let him find the leak from a drawing of the pipework.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A pressure tactic that presents the decisions of other people as evidence for your own.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The offer came with social proof: nine out of ten customers chose the larger plan.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A pressure tactic that claims the supply is limited, so that waiting looks like a loss.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The scarcity was easy to check: the shelf held six, not two.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: Money, time or effort that has already been spent, and which is used as a reason to continue.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The sunk cost of the training was the argument for staying in the job.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The power to decide which topics the public thinks about, exercised through selection and emphasis in coverage.
Influence over how a topic is understood: which frames, words and experts define it.
Influence achieved through attraction and information rather than force or payment.
Withholding one's own views to avoid social, professional or legal consequences.
The work of knowing one field deeply instead of many fields broadly.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Specialisation is why the same engineer finds a fault in ten minutes that takes another person a day.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A person whose work is in one field and who is trusted to judge work in that field.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: She is the specialist for the pump, so she read the report in ten minutes.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The area of work that a person, a document or a decision covers.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The scope of this decision covers the money, the contract and the customer.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A part of a situation that a person cannot see well, because of what the person already knows.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Her blind spot is the customer: the figure was right and nobody asked who was waiting for the machine.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The judgement of a second person, asked because the first one may not see everything.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Before we sign, I would like a second opinion from somebody outside this field.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The high-level structure of a system: how its parts are divided and connected, decided before the details are written.
The way a conflict is linked to its political purpose: what is wanted, with what means, over what time.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The strategy of the campaign was to hold the coast and wait.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: Strategy at the level of a whole state: how a country uses its power over years to reach a political aim.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Containment was the grand strategy, and deterrence was one of its tools.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A fixed amount you authorise to be paid on a schedule, whether or not the underlying bill is the same each month.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: I have a standing order to my landlord for the rent, and a direct debit for the utilities.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The job money does when it keeps its value over time, so a payment can be made today for something received later.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The balance in the account is a store of value for the bill that arrives next month.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The gain a state earns from issuing money.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The state's gain from a new note is seigniorage, because the note costs less to make than it buys.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: An amount measured at one moment, such as the balance on an account today.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The stock is 800 $ today, whatever the monthly flow was.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The difference between the price a shop buys at and the price it sells at.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The spread between the producer's price and the shelf price is already inside what you pay.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The unit of time equal to one sixtieth of a minute.
Matter of a definite kind and composition.
A written sign that stands for a quantity or an idea.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Read the symbol, then the English name.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A level of quality or a rule of conduct.
The checkpoint where bags and people are checked before entering the secure part of the airport.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Security screening starts at the end of this corridor.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The checkpoint where bags and people are checked before entering the secure part of the airport.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Security screening starts at the end of this corridor.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A starter, a main course and a dessert sold together at a single price. Often the cheapest and most predictable choice.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: I will take the set menu, please.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The small first course, such as soup, a salad or fried snacks.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: As a starter, I will have the soup.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A percentage added to the bill for service, usually 10 % or 15 %. When it is included, tipping again is not expected.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The service charge is already on the bill, so we will just round it up.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: Food bought from a stall or a small kitchen at the roadside. It is usually cheap, quick and freshly cooked, but the hygiene is worth watching.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Let us get something from a street stall near the station instead of waiting for a table.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: An ability that counts in a new job even when the industry or the title is different.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Project coordination is a transferable skill, whatever the sector.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: Any person or group affected by a decision, inside or outside the organisation.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: I had to keep three stakeholders updated without overloading them.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A payment made to an employee when a job ends, often calculated by years of service.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The package included three months of salary as severance.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A pressure tactic that claims the supply is limited, so that waiting looks like a loss.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The scarcity was easy to check: the shelf held six, not two.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A pressure tactic that presents the decisions of other people as evidence for your own.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The offer came with social proof: nine out of ten customers chose the larger plan.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: Money, time or effort that has already been spent, and which is used as a reason to continue.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: The sunk cost of the training was the argument for staying in the job.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The capacity to hold a reaction and choose when to act on it.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: He used self-regulation to stay in the room instead of walking out.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: How strongly and how fast a person reacts to pressure; a tempo, not a character.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Her stress reactivity is high in meetings and low in front of a machine.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: A belief about a group that is applied to a person without looking at that person.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: That sentence about men and women is a stereotype, and it settles nothing about the man in front of you.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The process of choosing a partner, from the first interest to the decision.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Mate selection was slow for her and quick for her brother.

search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.definition: The people who are actually available to you to choose from at a given time.
search-043a718774c572bd8a25adbeb1bfcd5c0.example: Your choice set is the people you actually meet, not everybody you like the idea of.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The cold chain was broken, so the date on the pack means nothing.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The roughly 24-hour cycle that sets your sleep, hormones, body temperature and appetite. Light is its strongest input.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: My circadian rhythm has shifted, because I have been going to bed at two every night.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A big old building with thick walls, made to keep people safe. Castles usually have towers and gates.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: From her window, Hà could see the castle on the hill.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The whole journey of an animal, from the egg all the way back to eggs again.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: A butterfly's life cycle has four stages.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The resting stage, when the insect changes its body. A butterfly's pupa is a chrysalis.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Inside the pupa, the caterpillar becomes a butterfly.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: All the eggs that one bird lays in one nest, counted together.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The blackbird's clutch has five eggs in it.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The band that goes around a dog's neck. It can hold a small tag with the dog's name.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Mum put Pip's name on his new collar.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: An animal that eats other animals. Carnivores are often the strong, heavy ones.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The heavy animal with the thick tail was a carnivore.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A question asking if you are allowed to have something. The person can answer yes or no.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Can I have a piece of bread?

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A softer way to ask, good for when you talk to somebody you do not know well.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Could I have the menu, please?

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A child who is in the same class as you. Classmates are the easiest people to be friends with.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Mai is my classmate, and she sits next to me.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: To bring your body back to quiet so you can think and speak.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Let us calm down first, then talk.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A mineral from food that makes your bones and teeth strong.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Milk is full of calcium, and calcium keeps my bones strong.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A small clock that rings in the morning to wake you up.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: My alarm clock rings at six.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A small bag or box that holds your pencils, pens, rubbers and ruler.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: My pencil case is the blue one.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A round shape with no corners. A wheel and a coin are circles.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The clock is a circle.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: When vapour cools and turns back into tiny drops of water, like the drops on a cold glass.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Condensation makes the cloud in the sky.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A huge group of tiny water drops, or ice crystals, floating together high in the air.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: That cloud is grey because it holds so much water.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A hole in a tooth. It forms when acid from plaque weakens the enamel.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The dentist filled my cavity yesterday.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The most the bank will let you borrow on the card at one time. Going over it is usually refused and sometimes charged.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: My credit limit is 2000 $, and I use about 600 $ of it.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The period between two statements. Everything bought in one cycle appears on the next statement.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The billing cycle closes on the 12th, so my groceries appear on the 12th statement.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The standard index of the price of a basket of goods and services bought by households. Its change over time is the headline inflation rate.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The consumer price index is the number the news report quotes.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The standard index of the price of a basket of goods and services bought by households. Its change over time is the headline inflation rate.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The consumer price index is the number the news report quotes.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The compulsory payment into the social insurance system that covers sickness, maternity, accidents and retirement.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: My social insurance contribution is a percentage of my gross pay.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: Money you paid for work that the company owes you back. It almost always needs a receipt and a deadline.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: I submitted the taxi receipts as an expense claim on Friday.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The result you decide to bring about when a boundary is crossed. It is chosen by you, and it should be small and repeatable.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Her consequence was simple: she stopped answering messages late at night.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: An intense feeling of attraction for someone you have not yet got close to.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: I have a crush on someone from my office, but we have only ever said hello.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: Everyone agreeing freely to something, every time. A clear no is a complete answer that needs no follow-up.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Consent has to be clear on both sides, and a no is always a complete answer.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A disagreement that improves the decision being made and leaves the working relationship intact.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The meeting was tense but productive — it ended with a constructive disagreement and a clear next step.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The part of a position that both people accept. Every polite disagreement starts by naming it.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Find the common ground first — both of you want this project to succeed.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A short sound or remark that shows you are following without taking the turn, such as 'mm' or 'really'.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: You say 'really?' and then let them keep going.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The short number a bank sends to confirm a login or a payment. Anyone who holds it can complete the action.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: I gave them the one-time code, and that was the moment the account was theirs.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A reversal of a card payment requested from the bank, usually because the transaction was not authorised or the goods never arrived.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The bank raised a chargeback and returned the money five days later.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The moment you take the room, normally from 14:00 or 15:00. Before it, the hotel usually stores your luggage free of charge.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Check-in is from 14:00, but I can leave my bags with you in the morning.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: Giving the room back and paying the final bill, usually between 10:00 and 12:00. Late check-out can often be arranged.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Can I check out at 14:00 instead of 11:00? My flight is at 17:00.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The staff member who arranges tickets, tours, taxis, doctors and anything else the hotel does not sell itself.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The concierge booked a table at a restaurant that was fully booked.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: To return to a topic later. Often used to postpone a decision.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Let us circle back to the budget question after lunch.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A building where residents rent a room and share a kitchen and common areas, and where nomads often find a community.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: I took a room in a coliving for a month and made friends in a week.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A paid workspace where people work in the same room, usually by the day or the month, with a desk and reliable internet.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: A co-working space costs less than the coffee I would buy sitting in a café all day.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The disorientation you feel when the everyday rules of a place stop matching the ones you grew up with.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Culture shock hit me the week I could not find a supermarket open after six.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The value a person draws from their relationships, and the trust that makes working together easier.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: A good boss spends a lot of the budget on building social capital.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The last stage of a wash, in which the drum turns fast to push water out of the fabric.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: A higher spin speed means the washing comes out drier.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A setting that stops the machine starting until you hold the lock button for a few seconds.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Hold the padlock button for three seconds to release the child lock.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The flow of electricity, measured in amperes (A).
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The current went back through the earth conductor instead of through the motor.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: Current that escapes from the live part of a cable or a pump through damaged insulation.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The electrician measured the leakage current before he ran the pump again.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The green-and-yellow wire that connects the metal parts of an installation to the earth.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The earth conductor was cut by a drill during the renovation.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A device that compares the current going out with the current coming back, and opens the circuit when they differ.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The residual-current device is the wide switch on the board with the test button.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A device that opens a circuit when the current is higher than the circuit is rated for.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The circuit breaker is the 16 A device on the board.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A condition in which the medicine must not be used, because the risk outweighs the benefit.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Pregnancy is a contraindication for this medicine, so I will ask about an alternative.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: Long-standing, generally present for more than three months.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: It has become a chronic problem, so I have started to manage it differently.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: An open space in the middle of woods, where the trees step back and the sky reaches the ground.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The path led to a small clearing.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A small hint. Clues come one after another, and each one points to the next.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The third clue was a picture of a bench and a nail.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A small tool with a needle that points north. Explorers use a compass so they walk in a straight line.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The compass needle spun because of the iron in the ground.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The place where a robot goes to fill its battery with energy.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Bit climbed down from the charging post.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A hard, colourful structure built by tiny animals. It looks like a plant but it is alive, so never touch it.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The orange coral stood up like a tree.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A structure built by coral animals out of limestone, full of holes where small fish hide.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The coral reef grows a little slower every year.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A child of your aunt or your uncle. A cousin is like a brother or sister, but not a real one.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: My cousin Mai is my age. We play together every weekend.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The sky has clouds in it. Clouds are about the sky, not about the temperature.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: It is cloudy this morning, but it is still warm.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The temperature is low. Cold is lower than cool.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: It is cold outside, so I am wearing my coat.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A nice thing you say about what somebody did or made.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: I gave her a compliment about her picture.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: Grain that you pour into milk and eat with a spoon.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: I ate cereal with cold milk.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: To make something cold so it tastes fresh.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: We chill the salad in the fridge for one hour.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A tall box with doors. Dry food and clean dishes are kept inside it.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The clean cups are in the cupboard.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The little spiral inside your ear that turns vibrations into nerve signals.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The cochlea changes the movement of your eardrum into signals.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The daily rhythm inside you that tells you when to be awake and when to be sleepy.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: My body clock wakes me up before the alarm.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A baby fox, wolf or bear. A cub is small and still needs looking after.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The cub sat down and shook the leaves off his fur.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The correction you add or subtract after you have rounded a number.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: I rounded 19 up to 20, so the compensation is one lot of 24, and 480 − 24 = 456.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: To bear or transport something.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: In 8 + 7 you write 5 and carry 1 to the next column.

The accuracy of your self-assessment: how closely your confidence matches your actual performance.

The ability you have to do something, whatever you decide to do it for.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Character is what you do when nobody is checking.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The argument made against a decision that is still being considered.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The counter-argument was short, and it changed the decision.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: Holding a decision back for a short time so that the second argument can be made.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: A little self-control before the reply is cheaper than a retraction later.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The sense that tells you an act would hurt somebody.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: His conscience told him the report would hurt the supplier.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The test that says whether something is good enough, or true enough.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The criterion for a useful fault report is not the length of it but the reason in it.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The pattern of strengths and weaknesses a person shows across different kinds of thinking.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Her cognitive profile is strong with people and weak with long tables of numbers.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A link between two facts, so that one explains, limits or changes the other.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: There is a connection between the load on the pump and the life of the seal.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The situation in front of you, with its own conditions, not the generic one.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: This case is not the case the manual was written for.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The situation around a fact that decides what the fact means.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: In the context of a night shift, that warning means something different.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The chips, data centers and energy supply that make training and running large models possible.
The removal of a real choice by force or by the threat of harm.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Sign the form today or lose the job — that is coercion, not persuasion.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: Money, time or effort that has already been spent, and which is used as a reason to continue.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The sunk cost of the training was the argument for staying in the job.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Consent has to be clear on both sides, and a no is always a complete answer.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A pattern in which one person keeps control over another by limiting their money, their time or their contact with other people.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The pattern of coercive control is recognised by what it restricts, not by what it says.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The pattern of coercive control is recognised by what it restricts, not by what it says.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: Agreement produced not by open discussion but by arranging the information environment so one conclusion appears natural.
Withholding one's own views to avoid social, professional or legal consequences.
The property of a set of axioms that do not contradict one another.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The two rules cannot both be true, so the set of rules is not consistent.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: Using external tools to store, compute or retrieve information so that your own mind does not have to.
The disciplined practice of examining claims, evidence and reasoning before accepting a conclusion.
The weakening of mental abilities through long disuse, similar to the shrinking of an unexercised muscle.
The capacity to direct one's own thinking: forming, testing and owning one's judgments rather than receiving them.
The ability to do a piece of work well.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: His competence is in the numbers; the rest of the project is not his field.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: Building software by prompting an AI and accepting generated code based on whether it seems to work, without necessarily understanding it.
The practice of having code read and checked by another developer — or by its author with fresh eyes — before it is accepted.
The underlying reason a problem exists, as opposed to the symptom that made it visible.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Compatibility showed up in the small things: the pace, the money, the quiet.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The people who are actually available to you to choose from at a given time.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: To live with a partner in the same home without being married to that person.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: They have cohabited for three years and still keep two homes.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The treatment of a person as a product that can be valued and exchanged.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The whole conversation turned her into a commodity, and she left the table.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The state in which too many options make the choosing harder instead of easier.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The effort a person pays to choose among the options available.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The set of rules a relationship runs on although nobody has written them down or said them aloud.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Their unspoken contract said that the person who plans also drives.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The removal of a real choice by force or by the threat of harm.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Sign the form today or lose the job — that is coercion, not persuasion.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The work of keeping other people fed, rested, healthy and connected.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Care work is the appointments, the meals and the phone calls, and it is still work.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The strain that appears when one person is expected to be two things at once and the two pull in different directions.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The role conflict was not a failure of effort; two jobs had been given to one week.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The phrase for the idea that time passes in the body as well as in the calendar, and that a window is closing.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The biological clock is a phrase, and the window it names is mostly a story.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A link between two facts, so that one explains, limits or changes the other.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A decision to keep something going at a cost to yourself, made again and again rather than once.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Commitment is not one decision; it is the tenth one as well as the first.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The state of being able to make the decision of commitment now, with the time, the wish and a picture of the cost.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: He has the wish and not the readiness, and he can tell the two apart.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The state in which the same goal pulls you towards it and away from it at the same time.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The approach-avoidance conflict is inside him, not in the other person.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The sequence of roles and stages people are expected to move through, in the usual order.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: A life course puts study and work before children for most people, and in a different order for others.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: Living together as a couple without being married.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Cohabitation moved their date, because the shared life came before the legal form.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The three-letter code that names a currency in the standard ISO 4217, used by banks, customs offices and computer systems.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: Write USD on the invoice, not the word dollar, so the system reads it.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The currency of the pair that the rate counts from: one unit of it is the thing you exchange.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: In EUR/USD the euro is the base currency and the dollar is the quote currency.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: The currency of the pair that the rate is expressed in, so the rate says how many units of it you get.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The rate is given in the quote currency, so a pair written EUR/USD reads in dollars.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: An arrangement in which several states use one currency and a single authority issues it for all of them.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: The euro area is a currency union, so one central bank issues the notes for every member country.

search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.definition: A country where most payments are still made in cash rather than by card or by transfer.
search-2e7d2c03a9507ae265ecf5b5356885a53.example: In a cash economy, a market stall may not have a machine at all.

search-2ea71c18131a7f0383294917672136b6d.definition: The official declaration that a document has been lost. It is what cancels the old document in the issuing country's records.
search-2ea71c18131a7f0383294917672136b6d.example: I have already filed the loss report for my passport.

search-2ea71c18131a7f0383294917672136b6d.definition: The weight a loss carries compared with a gain of the same size.
search-2ea71c18131a7f0383294917672136b6d.example: The same 20,000 hurt as a loss and helped as a saving.

search-2eb42bcde9c54e4ffbd39cd41254d9e58.definition: A planned event moved to a later date.
search-2eb42bcde9c54e4ffbd39cd41254d9e58.example: The postponement had a reason, and the reason was the contract.

search-2ec1aa243a8cb5fe05a6ad471cbb1fe2a.definition: A layered structure of simple units whose connection strengths are tuned during training. The most common structure in modern AI.
search-2ec1aa243a8cb5fe05a6ad471cbb1fe2a.example: The translation and the image search both run on a neural network.

search-2ec4fc0af5ad65d1daec6a8ab31efa34b.example: Could you store my luggage until my flight in the evening?

search-2ec6046d5f0f2c48f036420a40af6dbe3.example: A little hedging language keeps a sentence civil; too much of it hides your point.

search-2eca094654ff645c50cfeab3b0a1d3aa6.definition: Pairing with a person who is similar in background, position or values.
search-2eca094654ff645c50cfeab3b0a1d3aa6.example: Homogamy is the word for the couple who grew up in the same kind of city.

search-2ecbd613111342530a35f0a5ab8141ec4.example: Fertility is not a number that stays the same for a whole life.

search-2ed6b4c1ae9f8249477df9193d20e7547.example: My recall of the formula is good; my recall of the reason behind it is not.

search-2ef08770929ff4e71595d0b5718e57d88.definition: Using external tools to store, compute or retrieve information so that your own mind does not have to.

search-2ef3837d60289d724520ce19425e8cb7b.definition: The arrangement in which one person is placed below another and kept there.
search-2ef3837d60289d724520ce19425e8cb7b.example: The subordination was taught in the meeting: whoever spoke second was corrected first.

search-2f04a79ef13b95c1f6a2ebb41fd147624.definition: The proportion of useful information (signal) to everything else (noise) in a stream of content.

search-2f122b3412eaf9ce3eb092b0d8c16ba73.definition: The average daily amount of energy or a nutrient for an adult. A guide, not a target.
search-2f122b3412eaf9ce3eb092b0d8c16ba73.example: The reference intake for energy is about 2000 kilocalories a day.

search-2f122b3412eaf9ce3eb092b0d8c16ba73.definition: A person your former employer allows a new employer to contact to check your work history.
search-2f122b3412eaf9ce3eb092b0d8c16ba73.example: Could you give me a reference from your last manager?

search-2f1ce45956057d98a79c93a2f2d3028a4.definition: Stating your need, your limit or your disagreement without wrapping it in blame.
search-2f1ce45956057d98a79c93a2f2d3028a4.example: Assertiveness is saying the report is late and then saying what you need instead.

search-2f2fc7f2e9ce13b09b84f63d54d0b4a59.definition: To say out loud that you need it. It is not the same as complaining.
search-2f2fc7f2e9ce13b09b84f63d54d0b4a59.example: I asked for help and she came straight away.

search-2f48b881ea7073f1c6f083b296a360bd4.example: English works as the lingua franca, so nobody has to learn three languages for one meeting.

search-2f48b881ea7073f1c6f083b296a360bd4.example: It was really nice meeting you — see you around.

search-2f48b881ea7073f1c6f083b296a360bd4.example: 2x + 3 = 11 is a linear equation in one unknown.

search-2f48b881ea7073f1c6f083b296a360bd4.example: The lines of approach were limited by the marsh.

search-2f48b881ea7073f1c6f083b296a360bd4.example: The lines of communication were cut by the flood.

search-2f4a427c1c1c7fee48056c215ea7285a9.example: The timeline pressure came from the family, not from her body.

search-2f552d5b9c937e81c5219c2da107b713a.example: The vet says the puppy needs two more injections.

search-2f588afe14a613cb44993b87574220e5a.example: My nominal income rose, but not as fast as prices.

search-2f588afe14a613cb44993b87574220e5a.definition: Someone who earns income that does not depend on one country and who lives in several places over a year.
search-2f588afe14a613cb44993b87574220e5a.example: As a digital nomad, I move when the client contract ends.

search-2f588afe14a613cb44993b87574220e5a.example: The nomad visa requires proof of income above a monthly threshold.

search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.definition: The home a rabbit digs under the ground. It is soft and safe and it has a round door.
search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.example: Pip's burrow has a round door and soft walls.

search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.definition: Not feeling no fear, but going on anyway. Brave is about what you do, not what you feel.
search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.example: Pip was brave and took one more step.

search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.definition: The period between two statements. Everything bought in one cycle appears on the next statement.
search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.example: The billing cycle closes on the 12th, so my groceries appear on the 12th statement.

search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.example: With last year as the base year, the index now stands at 104.

search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.definition: A line you draw around your time, energy, body or values, and say out loud so other people can respect it.
search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.example: Her boundary was simple: no phone calls after ten.

search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.definition: Sending occasional messages to keep someone interested while never making any real plan.
search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.example: He messages me every few days but has never once suggested meeting.

search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.definition: A short sound or remark that shows you are following without taking the turn, such as 'mm' or 'really'.
search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.example: You say 'really?' and then let them keep going.

search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.definition: A temporary fix that makes a problem go away without solving it.
search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.example: We applied a band-aid to the payment process, but the real fix is in the accounting system.

search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.definition: To return to a topic later. Often used to postpone a decision.
search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.example: Let us circle back to the budget question after lunch.

search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.definition: To have a short conversation with someone about something.
search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.example: Can we touch base on Thursday for fifteen minutes?

search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.definition: Agreement and active support for a plan from the people who must carry it out.
search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.example: I spent two weeks getting buy-in from the regional teams.

search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.definition: A rough approximate number, given before the real figure is known.

search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.definition: The capacity a person or team has to take on more work.

The distance the car travels from the moment the driver touches the brake to the moment the car stops.
search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.example: On a wet road the braking distance is longer than on a dry road.

search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.definition: Braking at the limit of grip by pressing and releasing the pedal before the wheel locks.
search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.example: Without ABS the driver has to use threshold braking.

search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.definition: The loss of braking power when the brakes are hot, so that the pedal goes soft.
search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.example: After the long descent the brakes faded and the pedal felt weak.

search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.definition: Applying the brake with steadily increasing pressure instead of one sudden push.
search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.example: In heavy traffic she used progressive braking and the stop was smooth.

search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.definition: Slowing the car with the engine and the gearbox instead of with the brake pedal.
search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.example: On the long descent he used engine braking and the brakes stayed cool.

search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.definition: Water moving in the wrong direction, back along the pipe towards the pump.
search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.example: After the supply stops, backflow can leave the pump running with no water.

search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.definition: A device that opens a circuit when the current is higher than the circuit is rated for.
search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.example: The circuit breaker is the 16 A device on the board.

search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.definition: Joining metal parts to each other so that they cannot sit at different voltages.
search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.example: Bonding of the metal pipework is part of the installation.

search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.definition: A small switch you press to make something happen. Pressing a robot's button can wake it up.
search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.example: He pressed the button on the old robot's chest.

search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.definition: The big building on a farm where animals sleep and where the hay is kept.
search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.example: The ponies sleep in the barn on cold nights.

search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.definition: The first meal of the day, eaten after you wake up.

search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.definition: Thorny branches that grow together and hold on tightly to whatever touches them.
search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.example: Rusty's leg was caught in the brambles.

search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.definition: A habit of attention that leans one way, often without the person noticing.
search-3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348.example: The bias is not against the customer; it is away from the customer.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.example: I had a strong performance review, and I want to use it in my pay case.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.definition: A change of level within the same job, which usually comes with a pay band change.
search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.example: They suggested a regrade to senior analyst.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.definition: The pressure to return a favour that the other side has given you.
search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.example: The discount was the favour, and the renewal at the same price was the bill.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.definition: The capacity to hold a reaction and choose when to act on it.
search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.example: He used self-regulation to stay in the room instead of walking out.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.definition: How strongly and how fast a person reacts to pressure; a tempo, not a character.
search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.example: Her stress reactivity is high in meetings and low in front of a machine.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.definition: A span with a lower and an upper bound, used here for the ages a person will consider.
search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.example: Write your age range as two numbers, not as a feeling.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.definition: The state of being ready for a relationship, in time, money and emotional terms.
search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.example: Readiness was not there yet, and she said so plainly.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.definition: Asking a partner repeatedly to confirm that the relationship is still there.
search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.example: Reassurance-seeking is asking the same question until the answer changes.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.definition: A reply that takes the point that was made and answers it with a reason.
search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.example: The rebuttal gave the reason and asked for the same test on the other side.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.definition: Keeping the account but changing the words in it, until the meaning that was shared is gone.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.example: The reversal put the person who caused the harm in the place of the person who suffered it.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.definition: The state of being open to a relationship and willing to say yes to the right one.
search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.example: His romantic availability changed when he moved to another city, and he says so openly.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.definition: The ability to stay with a strong feeling and still choose what you do next.
search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.example: Her emotional regulation showed in the pause before she answered.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.definition: The way a person comes back down from activation and can choose again.
search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.example: His recovery took the whole walk home, and the call waited until then.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.definition: Changing the story you tell about an event so that the feeling loses its grip.
search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.example: His reappraisal was honest: the message had been sent late, and it was not about her.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.definition: Turning the same thought over again and again without moving towards an action.
search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.example: Her rumination ran for days, and the argument she started was never the one she had been thinking about.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.definition: An agreed action that puts a relationship back on track after something broke between two people.
search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.example: Their repair was simple: they agreed to talk again the next evening.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.definition: The pressure to return a favour that the other side has given you.
search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.example: The discount was the favour, and the renewal at the same price was the bill.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.definition: A rule about what a category of people is expected to do.
search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.example: The gender role said the man pays, and the rule was never written down.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.definition: The strain that appears when one person is expected to be two things at once and the two pull in different directions.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.definition: The talk in which two people change or confirm the roles they play together.
search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.example: Role negotiation is not a quarrel about who is right; it is a decision about who does what.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.definition: The way the reproductive system changes as a person gets older.
search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.example: Reproductive ageing is gradual, and it is not the same for everybody.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.definition: The felt push to act on reproduction because the window seems to be closing.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.definition: The state of being able to make the decision of commitment now, with the time, the wish and a picture of the cost.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.definition: The money part of readiness: a steady income, some savings and a housing situation that holds.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.definition: The price of one currency expressed in the money of another currency.
search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.example: Ask which day the exchange rate belongs to, because the number is only true for that day.

search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.definition: The money a person working abroad sends to the family at home.
search-454349e422f05297191ead13e21d3db52.example: He sends a remittance every month, and the rent is paid from it.

search-4551b393bcf263be3f116029355975e29.definition: An account that says why a fact holds, in words somebody else can follow.
search-4551b393bcf263be3f116029355975e29.example: The explanation of the fault was better than the manual, because it said why the seal failed.

search-4568e98aab54dbcebdeccacd2672b9725.definition: Whether a speaker pronounces the r sound at the end of a word. American English is rhotic; British English is not.

search-45c9a6614fccd4f9592d8283a4f25bff8.example: I feel sad because my cat is away.

search-45e285133b891bc3bc022fdd5eda0726b.example: Do I go through the red channel if I bought two bottles of wine?

search-45e84635bc4803c5cc5d456c798a13d37.example: A good boss spends a lot of the budget on building social capital.

search-45fb7c9d8437a774f2be44080f1d868a5.example: We carry two buckets of fodder to the cows.

search-46599c5bb5c33101f80cea8438e222808.definition: The date after which the food is still safe to eat but has gone down in quality. A quality date, not a safety date.

search-46599c5bb5c33101f80cea8438e222808.definition: A soft toy with fur. Many children hug it or sleep with it.

search-4666a3f66bc600ad9f11fa871e13e32f1.example: The circuit breaker is the 16 A device on the board.

search-466e5b9cd57fa444cceaa8e5b053ddd58.example: The shop takes only the local currency.

search-4691511b6bed23e521dbc641c352329c2.example: The consumer price index is the number the news report quotes.

search-46acbe5cf42ee3269d1c3c43a6b570edf.definition: The habit of adding a small sum on top of a bill for the person who served you.
search-46acbe5cf42ee3269d1c3c43a6b570edf.example: In this restaurant the service charge is on the bill, so there is no tip to add.

search-46b35139eb273e2979a90910d32f62611.example: Assortative mating was visible in the town: the teachers married teachers.

search-46fb99eddf88f3368ccd6f16f0c0300f9.example: Deliberation took two minutes, and the two minutes were enough.

search-4704267c2dc79cc95576f51bee3ab301a.example: The unwritten rule was that nobody questioned the schedule.

search-470b0e037712e71eb1fa2c64854b4490e.example: The deadline is pressure, but you can still say that you need more time.

search-470b0e037712e71eb1fa2c64854b4490e.example: The second call was a pressure tactic: it moved the deadline by one hour.

search-470b0e037712e71eb1fa2c64854b4490e.definition: The repeated sense that a status such as being single is a condition to be explained, corrected or ended.
search-470b0e037712e71eb1fa2c64854b4490e.example: The social pressure arrives in small questions, not in one cruel remark.

search-470b0e037712e71eb1fa2c64854b4490e.example: Generational pressure rarely sounds like a command; it sounds like an observation.

search-4715b734085d8d9c9981d91c6d5cff398.example: Broccoli and carrot are both vegetables.

search-4726a1bce9706083939a56b88b657a4c6.example: Their time horizon was ten years ahead; mine was two.

search-4726a1bce9706083939a56b88b657a4c6.definition: How far ahead the decision can see, which decides how urgent it feels.
search-4726a1bce9706083939a56b88b657a4c6.example: Our decision horizons are different lengths, and that is the disagreement.

search-472dc7749c49f123491f23fbaaaba25d4.definition: What a person says they want, before any particular person comes along.
search-472dc7749c49f123491f23fbaaaba25d4.example: My preference was somebody older; the person I chose was younger.

search-47c74332b23d41166843fff208f891445.example: She is the specialist for the pump, so she read the report in ten minutes.

search-9c84a80d07f2852e674fe97abf0f97f79.definition: Braking at the limit of grip by pressing and releasing the pedal before the wheel locks.
search-9c84a80d07f2852e674fe97abf0f97f79.example: Without ABS the driver has to use threshold braking.

search-9c84a80d07f2852e674fe97abf0f97f79.definition: Applying the brake with steadily increasing pressure instead of one sudden push.
search-9c84a80d07f2852e674fe97abf0f97f79.example: In heavy traffic she used progressive braking and the stop was smooth.

search-9c84a80d07f2852e674fe97abf0f97f79.definition: Slowing the car with the engine and the gearbox instead of with the brake pedal.
search-9c84a80d07f2852e674fe97abf0f97f79.example: On the long descent he used engine braking and the brakes stayed cool.

search-9c8c2643095d646511d620c0ed7cb9741.definition: A shape with four sides and four corners. It is longer than it is wide. A book is a rectangle.

search-9ca4e1e8ced384f2acd189622b4dd4671.definition: When vapour cools and turns back into tiny drops of water, like the drops on a cold glass.
search-9ca4e1e8ced384f2acd189622b4dd4671.example: Condensation makes the cloud in the sky.

search-9cce132638bc6eb516098fc263a856ffa.definition: An arrangement in which several states use one currency and a single authority issues it for all of them.
search-9cce132638bc6eb516098fc263a856ffa.example: The euro area is a currency union, so one central bank issues the notes for every member country.

search-9cfa1468c93fc18652e34a000f0c6614b.definition: The accumulated gap between the sleep you have had and the sleep you need. It can be partly repaid, but slowly.
search-9cfa1468c93fc18652e34a000f0c6614b.example: I have been building up sleep debt for three weeks of early starts.

search-9cfa1468c93fc18652e34a000f0c6614b.definition: The future cost of shortcuts in software: work that must be redone because quick solutions were chosen over correct ones.
Money leaving the account. On a statement it is usually shown with a minus sign or in a column headed money out.
search-9cfa1468c93fc18652e34a000f0c6614b.example: The debit for the supermarket is 64 $, so that is the debit column, not the credit column.

search-9cfa1468c93fc18652e34a000f0c6614b.definition: A payment a company is authorised to take from your account on a date, without asking you again each time.
search-9cfa1468c93fc18652e34a000f0c6614b.example: The electricity bill is a direct debit, so it leaves my account on the 10th every month.

search-9cfa1468c93fc18652e34a000f0c6614b.definition: What you owe to somebody, and the amount the interest is charged on.
search-9cfa1468c93fc18652e34a000f0c6614b.example: The debt is 1 000 $, and the interest is charged on the part that is still left.

search-9d0289fd3be7607851eea7a7524a22585.definition: Heated quickly to kill tiny germs, so the milk stays safe to drink.
search-9d0289fd3be7607851eea7a7524a22585.example: This milk is pasteurised, so it is safe to drink.

search-9d04b084e143996d7c441cae7ba65492c.example: Total sugars are 20 g, and added sugars are 15 g of that.

search-9d0ca955031b5d23d4d735f0c9f4d5606.definition: The chips, data centers and energy supply that make training and running large models possible.

search-9d17a54e123183f1ff41004393d86029a.definition: The network of hardware, software, standards and services that a technology depends on to function.

search-9d31fd37a1c39789098e7bd87d52ef1cb.definition: A form of English used by a particular group in a particular place, with its own vocabulary, grammar and pronunciation.
search-9d31fd37a1c39789098e7bd87d52ef1cb.example: Singapore English is a variety of English, not a broken version of it.

search-9d342244e93851e7f8706dd00084e0cce.definition: The investigation of claims, numbers and risks before committing money or reputation.

search-9d342244e93851e7f8706dd00084e0cce.example: Either we cut the budget by a third, or the service stops — that is a false dilemma.

search-9d586dc0a48a2ed04839e0a6975089343.definition: Reading what another person feels, and taking it seriously enough to act on it.
search-9d586dc0a48a2ed04839e0a6975089343.example: Her empathy showed in the question she asked instead of the advice she gave.

search-9d586dc0a48a2ed04839e0a6975089343.definition: The feeling part of empathy: catching what the other person feels.
search-9d586dc0a48a2ed04839e0a6975089343.example: Affective empathy made her notice that the new engineer was frightened in the group.

search-9d586dc0a48a2ed04839e0a6975089343.definition: The thinking part of empathy: seeing the situation from the other person's side.
search-9d586dc0a48a2ed04839e0a6975089343.example: Cognitive empathy is what lets you guess that the deadline was the real problem.

search-9d61a31433ceeceee509e9650d593808c.example: The pattern was DARVO: deny, attack, and reverse victim and offender.

search-9d6253f26f444262d7a73592f62383f3f.example: The road surface was loose gravel, so a locked wheel was the shorter stop.

search-9d6f965ac832e40a5df6c06afe983e3b4.definition: The clinician's shortlist of possible causes, kept in mind while they examine you and order tests.
search-9d6f965ac832e40a5df6c06afe983e3b4.example: The doctor said the differential included three possibilities, and explained each one.

search-9d74932bdb6f21dc7ab21d6fc5260f474.example: I fill my water bottle at home.

search-9d77dd1d7538112ff653ff2f763400199.example: A test that everybody passes has poor discriminability.

search-9d96e17fd46eb91085fe8e47f714bd58f.example: Clausewitz wrote that war is the continuation of politics by other means.

search-9d9ae818441c28469f805cd3414b8ffda.definition: A dark shape that appears when something blocks the light.
search-9d9ae818441c28469f805cd3414b8ffda.example: The old tree made a long shadow on the path.

search-9da417b6dd86ac1539156d3f4bd5618da.definition: A game with many pieces. You fit the pieces together to make a picture.
search-9da417b6dd86ac1539156d3f4bd5618da.example: I finished the puzzle before dinner.

search-9dc2bc0330015819d3b32cd39f4f0d707.definition: Pressure strong enough to take away a person's freedom to decide, in the sense used in law and in medical consent.
search-9dc2bc0330015819d3b32cd39f4f0d707.example: The form said the signature was voluntary; the manager's tone made that undue influence.

search-9dc2bc0330015819d3b32cd39f4f0d707.example: Influence is not a privilege: the newest member of the team influences the oldest one as well.

search-9df6b026a8c6c26e3c3acd2370a16e93f.definition: A percentage added to the bill for service, usually 10 % or 15 %. When it is included, tipping again is not expected.
search-9df6b026a8c6c26e3c3acd2370a16e93f.example: The service charge is already on the bill, so we will just round it up.
