search-9df92a09c9386e8748c964d0dbf6cc9be.example: Mai is my classmate, and she sits next to me.

search-9df92a09c9386e8748c964d0dbf6cc9be.example: I submitted the taxi receipts as an expense claim on Friday.

search-9e34458dcf04af1231e2e249e437761af.definition: Soft words that mark your opinion as your opinion, such as 'maybe' or 'I could be wrong'. Useful in small doses.

search-9f4e2a19a862c3fca39159253ab7efb18.example: Specialisation is why the same engineer finds a fault in ten minutes that takes another person a day.

search-9f584196e7fe6de85d3898bc0b11c78b1.definition: A question asking if you are allowed to have something. The person can answer yes or no.

search-aaa9402664f1a41f40ebbc52c9993eb66.example: Hyperactivation turned three unanswered messages into an hour of checking the phone.

search-aaa9402664f1a41f40ebbc52c9993eb66.example: When one partner earns more, the pairing is hypogamy from one side and hypergamy from the other.

search-aaa9402664f1a41f40ebbc52c9993eb66.definition: Pairing with a person who has more of a valued resource, such as income, education or position, than the chooser.
search-aaa9402664f1a41f40ebbc52c9993eb66.example: Hypergamy names the direction of the pairing, and the direction can be read from either side.

search-aaa9402664f1a41f40ebbc52c9993eb66.definition: The arrangement of roles that says who decides and who answers for the decision.

search-aac730c2a32a144b5692c85cdbca3eb88.example: Menopause is a biological event, not a date on a calendar.

search-c83b701dffdc6ee013976f28d47c45849.definition: The substance in the medicine that produces the effect. Every other substance in the pack is only there to help it.
search-c83b701dffdc6ee013976f28d47c45849.example: The active ingredient is the same in both packs, only the strength differs.

search-c8444d3af84b850154922022ed1cc11e7.definition: Asking a partner repeatedly to confirm that the relationship is still there.
search-c8444d3af84b850154922022ed1cc11e7.example: Reassurance-seeking is asking the same question until the answer changes.

search-c84c8016356014e02b049ff270c079dd0.definition: The interest rate minus the inflation rate. It is the return a saver actually keeps in purchasing power.
search-c84c8016356014e02b049ff270c079dd0.example: A 4 % deposit with 6 % inflation gives a real interest rate of minus 2 %.

search-c84c8016356014e02b049ff270c079dd0.definition: What happens when a medicine meets another medicine, or alcohol, or a particular food. Some are dangerous.
search-c84c8016356014e02b049ff270c079dd0.example: There is an interaction with this antibiotic, so I will tell the pharmacist about everything I take.

search-c84c8016356014e02b049ff270c079dd0.definition: A user interface that changes according to context, intent and history rather than showing fixed menus.
The meaning a reader gives a result in their own work once they have understood it.
search-c84c8016356014e02b049ff270c079dd0.example: The interpretation is the last step: the number is correct, and now it has to mean something on the night shift.

search-c84c8016356014e02b049ff270c079dd0.definition: The price of borrowing money, charged as a percentage of what you still owe.
search-c84c8016356014e02b049ff270c079dd0.example: At 2 % a year on a debt of 1 000 $, the interest for the year is 20 $.

search-c84c8016356014e02b049ff270c079dd0.definition: An interview with several interviewers at once, often one from each department of the company.
search-c84c8016356014e02b049ff270c079dd0.example: It was a panel interview, so I introduced myself briefly at the start.

search-c86872dc97dd35aabbbd845130a5fcd62.definition: A form of English used by a particular group in a particular place, with its own vocabulary, grammar and pronunciation.
search-c86872dc97dd35aabbbd845130a5fcd62.example: Singapore English is a variety of English, not a broken version of it.

search-c86872dc97dd35aabbbd845130a5fcd62.definition: A reward schedule where the outcome is unpredictable. Unpredictable rewards keep a behaviour going far longer than predictable ones.
search-c86872dc97dd35aabbbd845130a5fcd62.example: You keep opening the app because you never know which post will be interesting.

search-c86872dc97dd35aabbbd845130a5fcd62.definition: A symbol, often x, whose value is found by solving.
search-c86872dc97dd35aabbbd845130a5fcd62.example: Let x be the unknown variable.

search-c89792af6595e6a14291ec25ea57b34bb.definition: The staff member who arranges tickets, tours, taxis, doctors and anything else the hotel does not sell itself.
search-c89792af6595e6a14291ec25ea57b34bb.example: The concierge booked a table at a restaurant that was fully booked.

search-c898ab690b82d903b50458f17f5d2da93.definition: The soft, sticky mix of flour and water before it is baked.
search-c898ab690b82d903b50458f17f5d2da93.example: I put the dough in a bowl and covered it.

search-c89b6c3d164a650911703c604c2add0e1.definition: The material under the tyre: tarmac, concrete, gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice or leaves.
search-c89b6c3d164a650911703c604c2add0e1.example: The road surface was loose gravel, so a locked wheel was the shorter stop.

search-c8b1a1a3e6bcee8660ad4a4ab2e2d3182.definition: Saying something you know is not true, on purpose, to make things easier for yourself.
search-c8b1a1a3e6bcee8660ad4a4ab2e2d3182.example: He could have said the wind broke the bowl, but that would be a lie.

search-c8b28c7b2dd741f8369408225e6ed220e.definition: The shared system by which a group, or a person and a tool, divides the work of remembering who knows what.

search-c8bd96951f8556703e01899025f78fa99.definition: The pattern in which partners tend to be similar to each other on age, schooling, place or work.
search-c8bd96951f8556703e01899025f78fa99.example: Assortative mating was visible in the town: the teachers married teachers.

search-c8c5beb7abe0f4436b63848c21626fce9.definition: One person goes first, and then the other one goes. It is how two people share one thing fairly.
search-c8c5beb7abe0f4436b63848c21626fce9.example: We took turns on the swing.

search-c8c78b21c248a879d7bb6ecc352811489.definition: Withholding one's own views to avoid social, professional or legal consequences.

search-c8cf701f30ad11d3ee877dced0d774ab2.definition: An animal that people keep on a farm to help them, like a cow or a chicken.
search-c8cf701f30ad11d3ee877dced0d774ab2.example: My uncle has a farm with cows and chickens.

search-c8e67683c9f04ef0310ce9579c189bacc.definition: The nerve that carries the picture from your eye to your brain.
search-c8e67683c9f04ef0310ce9579c189bacc.example: The optic nerve carries the picture along to the brain.

search-c8e67683c9f04ef0310ce9579c189bacc.definition: The cable that carries messages inside your body, from the senses to the brain and back again.
search-c8e67683c9f04ef0310ce9579c189bacc.example: A nerve carries the message from your finger to your brain.

search-c8f3d8495f45b20e2a2292f00fbf33bdd.definition: The question of when to marry, and the order of the events that answer it.
search-c8f3d8495f45b20e2a2292f00fbf33bdd.example: Marriage timing is two questions: when the marriage happens, and when the life does.

search-c8f3d8495f45b20e2a2292f00fbf33bdd.definition: The state of a group in which marriage is entered later than it used to be.
search-c8f3d8495f45b20e2a2292f00fbf33bdd.example: Deferred marriage is the name for a group-wide move to a later date.

search-c8f6d6dfe22c4b2a11b02985f2dc2f4d5.definition: The distance the car travels from the moment the driver touches the brake to the moment the car stops.
search-c8f6d6dfe22c4b2a11b02985f2dc2f4d5.example: On a wet road the braking distance is longer than on a dry road.

search-c8fc6bf296faa18d058b23f9a467243a6.definition: A span with a lower and an upper bound, used here for the ages a person will consider.
search-c8fc6bf296faa18d058b23f9a467243a6.example: Write your age range as two numbers, not as a feeling.

search-c90eb409dc4872032f3d4aab81f8ccda0.definition: The general help your embassy gives to its own citizens abroad, including lost documents, medical emergencies and legal problems.
search-c90eb409dc4872032f3d4aab81f8ccda0.example: They put me in contact with consular assistance straight away.

search-c912eef2e5eb9fe09f9b73579c19411d4.definition: The grip between the tyre and the road, and it is what turns the car's speed into a stop.
search-c912eef2e5eb9fe09f9b73579c19411d4.example: There is little traction on ice, so the car slides even at a low speed.

search-c91b81174517a4684ebc27b80e0f3b7fe.definition: The capacity to make good technical decisions under uncertainty, weighing trade-offs that no rule can settle.
The ability to form an opinion from experience and to defend it.
search-c91b81174517a4684ebc27b80e0f3b7fe.example: The judgement to stop the line is part of what the company pays for.

search-c9349dabb6a092747a12efa704308b390.definition: To clean your teeth with a toothbrush and toothpaste, usually for two minutes.
search-c9349dabb6a092747a12efa704308b390.example: I brush my teeth before I put on my pyjamas.

search-c94ca5acb0fedd5478092f6cfb2997a1e.definition: A shape that several facts share, which is easier to see than the facts themselves.
search-c94ca5acb0fedd5478092f6cfb2997a1e.example: The same pattern is in all three faults: the seal starts to leak before the part fails.

search-c955506fc1ccc8df3d686e53ba359c256.definition: The last date on which the maker guarantees the medicine keeps its strength and its safety.
search-c955506fc1ccc8df3d686e53ba359c256.example: The expiry date is on the strip, so I checked the one on the box too.

search-c96c6d5be8d08a12e7b5cdc1b207fa6b2.definition: The tokens you send, counted and billed on the way in. Documents and chat history both count here.
search-c96c6d5be8d08a12e7b5cdc1b207fa6b2.example: Uploading the same file twice charges the input tokens twice.

search-c971199ba2f0f3bc718b033cae5fb8da6.definition: The little spiral inside your ear that turns vibrations into nerve signals.
search-c971199ba2f0f3bc718b033cae5fb8da6.example: The cochlea changes the movement of your eardrum into signals.

search-c974e17b8e7321ce8c12983de3d0ed4a2.definition: The door onto the aircraft, identified by a letter and a number, for example B22. It is assigned late and can change.
search-c974e17b8e7321ce8c12983de3d0ed4a2.example: My gate has changed from B22 to C4.

search-c97ace4c8fef2cee8fa0f3c9f52aab18d.definition: The practice of having code read and checked by another developer — or by its author with fresh eyes — before it is accepted.
A regular discussion of your pay, often once a year, separate from a performance review.
search-c97ace4c8fef2cee8fa0f3c9f52aab18d.example: My pay review is at the end of March, so I asked to be included.

search-c97ace4c8fef2cee8fa0f3c9f52aab18d.definition: A formal conversation with your manager about your work and how you are doing, usually held before a pay review.
search-c97ace4c8fef2cee8fa0f3c9f52aab18d.example: I had a strong performance review, and I want to use it in my pay case.

search-c97bbf9039194863b01939bc6a3b1e721.definition: A soft toy with fur. Many children hug it or sleep with it.
search-c97bbf9039194863b01939bc6a3b1e721.example: My teddy bear sleeps on my pillow.

search-c9abc6facc11c919124e1b0fdc98e776d.definition: Any person or group affected by a decision, inside or outside the organisation.
search-c9abc6facc11c919124e1b0fdc98e776d.example: I had to keep three stakeholders updated without overloading them.

search-c9af477d19b132dbcda4ebbaa61c923d2.definition: A valve on the tank that opens and releases water if the pressure or the temperature inside becomes too high.
search-c9af477d19b132dbcda4ebbaa61c923d2.example: The safety valve is the small brass valve on the cold pipe.

search-c9d7325e4f48f8a4477169c627040c4b9.definition: A long journey that animals make every year to follow the rain and the new grass.
search-c9d7325e4f48f8a4477169c627040c4b9.example: The wildebeest migration crosses the whole savanna.

search-c9d9d2c4be976b707a1acdcaba8495e7e.definition: The word for your mum and your dad together.
search-c9d9d2c4be976b707a1acdcaba8495e7e.example: My parents work at the weekend too.

search-c9d9d2c4be976b707a1acdcaba8495e7e.definition: The historical lag between the arrival of a transformative technology and its measurable effect on economic productivity.
The pattern in which removing difficulty lowers the tolerance for difficulty, making life feel harder even as it gets easier.
The numbers inside a model that hold what it learned. Each one is a weight that raises or lowers the chance of a continuation.
search-c9d9d2c4be976b707a1acdcaba8495e7e.example: The model has billions of parameters, and not one of them is a sentence you can read.

search-c9d9d2c4be976b707a1acdcaba8495e7e.definition: One adjustable number inside a model. Models are described by how many parameters they have.
search-c9d9d2c4be976b707a1acdcaba8495e7e.example: A model with more parameters can hold more patterns, but it also needs more data and more computing.

search-c9d9d2c4be976b707a1acdcaba8495e7e.definition: Describing a person who has a romantic relationship, whether or not they live with the other person.
search-c9d9d2c4be976b707a1acdcaba8495e7e.example: She is partnered, and her partner works in another city.

search-c9d9d2c4be976b707a1acdcaba8495e7e.definition: The market that trades a currency outside the official channel, at a rate the state does not set.
search-c9d9d2c4be976b707a1acdcaba8495e7e.example: When the official rate stops working, the parallel market sets the real price of the dollar.

search-c9e949c0039a95d182a61944964878ed1.definition: The ability to handle shapes, positions and how parts fit together.
search-c9e949c0039a95d182a61944964878ed1.example: Spatial reasoning is what let him find the leak from a drawing of the pipework.

search-c9f943332257b022c3c1131e23c9199e8.definition: A relationship that has no agreed label. Nobody has said what it is, and nobody has asked.
search-c9f943332257b022c3c1131e23c9199e8.example: We have been seeing each other for months and calling it a situationship.

search-ca00fccfb408989eddc401062c4d1219a.definition: A wrong result or a report of a fault.

search-ca27e538f3b183aad14e8076310781edf.definition: The written record the local police make about a loss or theft. Most embassies require one before issuing any document.
search-ca27e538f3b183aad14e8076310781edf.example: Here is my police report; the reference number is on the first page.

search-ca27e538f3b183aad14e8076310781edf.definition: The official declaration that a document has been lost. It is what cancels the old document in the issuing country's records.
search-ca27e538f3b183aad14e8076310781edf.example: I have already filed the loss report for my passport.

search-ca27e538f3b183aad14e8076310781edf.definition: A new full passport issued after the old one is reported lost. It takes longer than an emergency document but works normally.
search-ca27e538f3b183aad14e8076310781edf.example: The replacement passport will be ready in five working days.

search-ca27e538f3b183aad14e8076310781edf.definition: An agreed action that puts a relationship back on track after something broke between two people.
search-ca27e538f3b183aad14e8076310781edf.example: Their repair was simple: they agreed to talk again the next evening.

search-ca27e538f3b183aad14e8076310781edf.definition: The way the reproductive system changes as a person gets older.
search-ca27e538f3b183aad14e8076310781edf.example: Reproductive ageing is gradual, and it is not the same for everybody.

search-ca27e538f3b183aad14e8076310781edf.definition: The felt push to act on reproduction because the window seems to be closing.
search-ca27e538f3b183aad14e8076310781edf.example: The reproductive urgency was real, and the deadline behind it was still unchecked.

search-ca2fc8a6f064d496f61b778ada6acbae7.definition: An animal that eats other animals. Carnivores are often the strong, heavy ones.
search-ca2fc8a6f064d496f61b778ada6acbae7.example: The heavy animal with the thick tail was a carnivore.

search-ca4176138ea4086faada5ec84e0867418.definition: The feeling you get when your body wants food and needs energy.
search-ca4176138ea4086faada5ec84e0867418.example: I am hungry, so I will have some bread.

search-ca4ec502c0aa94a7b9734b57617b41445.definition: Reading what another person feels, and taking it seriously enough to act on it.
search-ca4ec502c0aa94a7b9734b57617b41445.example: Her empathy showed in the question she asked instead of the advice she gave.

search-ca4ec502c0aa94a7b9734b57617b41445.definition: The feeling part of empathy: catching what the other person feels.
search-ca4ec502c0aa94a7b9734b57617b41445.example: Affective empathy made her notice that the new engineer was frightened in the group.

search-ca4ec502c0aa94a7b9734b57617b41445.definition: The thinking part of empathy: seeing the situation from the other person's side.
search-ca4ec502c0aa94a7b9734b57617b41445.example: Cognitive empathy is what lets you guess that the deadline was the real problem.

search-ca5bcec12f716f44d9745d349cc80422f.definition: The store of energy that makes a robot move. When it runs low, the robot has to plug in.
search-ca5bcec12f716f44d9745d349cc80422f.example: Bit's battery was getting low by the afternoon.

search-ca5bcec12f716f44d9745d349cc80422f.definition: The best deal you can make if the deal in front of you does not happen.
search-ca5bcec12f716f44d9745d349cc80422f.example: Before the meeting he wrote down his BATNA: the other supplier, the price and the date.

search-ca73f61034afc26d96c85c0d2285e1f08.definition: A small part at each wheel that reports how fast that wheel is turning.
search-ca73f61034afc26d96c85c0d2285e1f08.example: A damaged sensor at one wheel can switch the ABS off.

search-ca73f61034afc26d96c85c0d2285e1f08.definition: A small sense organ on a robot. It tells the robot what is around it, or how it feels.
search-ca73f61034afc26d96c85c0d2285e1f08.example: Bit's sensor flashed red when he was worried.

search-ca75eaf4e00caa4b9b1d4777599f18dd3.definition: Doing a calculation in your head, without a calculator and without paper.
search-ca75eaf4e00caa4b9b1d4777599f18dd3.example: Mental arithmetic gave me the rough figure, and the check gave me the right one.

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: The way the sounds of a language are pronounced by a speaker, independent of which words they use.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: He has a strong Glasgow accent but standard vocabulary.

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: The service that comes to help a broken-down car. It comes through insurance, a manufacturer package or a separate membership.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: Do you know whether my roadside assistance covers a call-out in this area?

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: A substance in food that can cause a serious allergic reaction in some people. There are fourteen that have to be declared.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: The allergen box says it contains peanuts and soya.

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: Sugar the manufacturer added, as distinct from sugar that came with the fruit or the milk.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: Total sugars are 20 g, and added sugars are 15 g of that.

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: Repeated pauses in breathing during sleep, usually with snoring and gasping. You usually cannot notice it yourself.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: My partner says I stop breathing in my sleep, so I will ask about sleep apnoea.

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: The two thin feelers on an insect's head. They help it smell and feel its way.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: The butterfly uses its antennae to find the flowers.

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: An animal that lives on its own in nature, not with people.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: A tiger is a wild animal. We must keep far away from it.

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: An animal that people keep on a farm to help them, like a cow or a chicken.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: My uncle has a farm with cows and chickens.

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: A medical reaction to a food, which can be dangerous. It must be told to the staff as an allergy, not as a dislike.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: I have a shellfish allergy. Is this dish safe for me?

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: A hot, upset feeling. It often comes fast and shows in your hands and face.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: I feel angry, so I am going to count to ten.

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: A small clock that rings in the morning to wake you up.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: My alarm clock rings at six.

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: The shape of a wing. The curved top and flat bottom help the air push the wing up.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: A good airfoil makes lift with less speed.

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: Saying something you know is not true, on purpose, to make things easier for yourself.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: He could have said the wind broke the bowl, but that would be a lie.

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: Something you say you will do. People remember a broken promise for a long time.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: An promised to tell his mother everything from then on.

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: The yearly price of borrowing on the card, with most fees included. It is the number to compare two cards by.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: This card has a 24 % APR, which is about 0.066 % a day.

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: The yearly price of borrowing on the card, with most fees included. It is the number to compare two cards by.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: This card has a 24 % APR, which is about 0.066 % a day.

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: Listening to understand the other person's point, including checking your understanding, instead of waiting for your turn to speak.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: Active listening means repeating their concern back before you answer it.

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: The length of time you can hold focus on one task. It depends on the task and on your state, not on a fixed personal rating.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: My attention span on a spreadsheet is fine; it is the phone that breaks it.

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: The part of the previous task still in your head after you stop it, which lowers the quality of the next task.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: I checked messages between every paragraph, so both pieces of work suffered.

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: A bank account used to receive and pass on criminal money, sometimes opened by someone who believes they are helping a company or a cause.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: They asked me to receive money and pass it on. That makes my account a mule account and the money is stolen.

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: Money demanded before a service is delivered. Common in fake job offers, fake investments and fake love interests.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: They wanted a small fee before the equipment arrived, and then a larger one.

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: A temporary fix that makes a problem go away without solving it.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: We applied a band-aid to the payment process, but the real fix is in the accounting system.

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: The rate of change of velocity with time.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: A car that speeds up from 0 to 100 km/h in 10 s has an acceleration of 2.78 m/s².

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: The finished state of living comfortably in a new culture, when the local way no longer feels strange.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: After a year, adaptation: I queue without thinking about it now.

A liquid added to the wide compartment of the drawer that makes water sheet off the dishes so they dry without spots.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: The rinse aid symbol is lit, so I need to top up the wide compartment.

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: A rod of metal that corrodes instead of the tank, so that the tank wall is saved.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: The anode rod is checked at every service and replaced when it is worn away.

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: The substance in the medicine that produces the effect. Every other substance in the pack is only there to help it.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: The active ingredient is the same in both packs, only the strength differs.

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: The licence number under which the medicine is sold. It identifies the pack in the regulator's records.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: The marketing authorisation number is printed at the bottom of the carton, and I quoted it in the report.

search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.definition: Coming on quickly and lasting a short time, usually days.
search-ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da.example: This is an acute episode, and it started yesterday.

search-dd687dc872410fef9fe0c13ecc853b7ac.definition: The year the price index starts from, set to 100. Changing it resets the index without changing any actual prices.
search-dd687dc872410fef9fe0c13ecc853b7ac.example: With last year as the base year, the index now stands at 104.

search-dd687dc872410fef9fe0c13ecc853b7ac.definition: A tiny living fungus that eats sugar in the flour and makes gas.
search-dd687dc872410fef9fe0c13ecc853b7ac.example: We woke up the yeast in warm water for ten minutes.

search-dd7a946de80abf41797036335be60bf20.definition: Money you paid for work that the company owes you back. It almost always needs a receipt and a deadline.
search-dd7a946de80abf41797036335be60bf20.example: I submitted the taxi receipts as an expense claim on Friday.

search-dd7a946de80abf41797036335be60bf20.definition: The last date on which the maker guarantees the medicine keeps its strength and its safety.
search-dd7a946de80abf41797036335be60bf20.example: The expiry date is on the strip, so I checked the one on the box too.

search-dd7a946de80abf41797036335be60bf20.definition: Deep skill and knowledge in one narrow field, built up over years of practice.
search-dd7a946de80abf41797036335be60bf20.example: Her expertise on the press line made her the only person who could set the machine up.

search-dd7a946de80abf41797036335be60bf20.definition: An account that says why a fact holds, in words somebody else can follow.
search-dd7a946de80abf41797036335be60bf20.example: The explanation of the fault was better than the manual, because it said why the seal failed.

search-dd7a946de80abf41797036335be60bf20.definition: A belief about what will happen if you say nothing and do nothing about it.
search-dd7a946de80abf41797036335be60bf20.example: Her expectation was that a refusal would come with an alternative.

search-dd7a946de80abf41797036335be60bf20.definition: The gap between what two people in a relationship each expect, when neither has said it aloud.
search-dd7a946de80abf41797036335be60bf20.example: The expectation mismatch was about phone calls, and it had been there for months.

search-dd7a946de80abf41797036335be60bf20.definition: How a person presents their gender through clothes, voice, gesture and behaviour.
search-dd7a946de80abf41797036335be60bf20.example: His gender expression changed when he started a new job, and the fit got easier.

search-dd889c661913abe1819d638c290ea3580.definition: Any amount taken off gross pay before payment, whether required by law or agreed with you.
search-dd889c661913abe1819d638c290ea3580.example: The canteen charge is a deduction, so it comes out before my net pay.

search-dd889c661913abe1819d638c290ea3580.definition: The step that carries you from what is already accepted to what follows from it.
search-dd889c661913abe1819d638c290ea3580.example: By logical deduction, the conclusion follows from the premises, and nothing else is needed.

search-dd9951c3806be56611d9d95d370acb54e.definition: Pairing with a person who has less of a valued resource, such as income, education or position, than the chooser.
search-dd9951c3806be56611d9d95d370acb54e.example: When one partner earns more, the pairing is hypogamy from one side and hypergamy from the other.

search-ddae89d7ff30f88b1abefb0b6ae2aabd6.definition: The period between two statements. Everything bought in one cycle appears on the next statement.
search-ddae89d7ff30f88b1abefb0b6ae2aabd6.example: The billing cycle closes on the 12th, so my groceries appear on the 12th statement.

search-ddb1c6b76031530587a3f4da9b34a42db.definition: To say your name to somebody for the first time. It only means saying your name.
search-ddb1c6b76031530587a3f4da9b34a42db.example: I introduced myself and said, I am An.

search-ddbbfd66eec42b0d82772b00f74186578.definition: Phishing carried out by a phone call, usually with a claim of authority from a bank, a police force or a support line.
search-ddbbfd66eec42b0d82772b00f74186578.example: They called pretending to be the tax office. That is vishing, and I hung up and called the real number.

search-ddbbfd66eec42b0d82772b00f74186578.definition: A residence permit for people who work remotely for foreign employers or clients without a local work permit.
search-ddbbfd66eec42b0d82772b00f74186578.example: The nomad visa requires proof of income above a monthly threshold.

search-ddc64e4410c5dd4965997bc3aab0942db.definition: When two friends get angry with each other. Every friendship has these.
search-ddc64e4410c5dd4965997bc3aab0942db.example: We had a quarrel and made up the same afternoon.

search-ddc6e2b224d0fd821669202258386936f.definition: A pump whose motor is sealed in a case that works under water.
search-ddc6e2b224d0fd821669202258386936f.example: A submersible pump hangs on a cable inside the well.

search-ddc6e2b224d0fd821669202258386936f.definition: Matter of a definite kind and composition.
The arrangement in which one person is placed below another and kept there.
search-ddc6e2b224d0fd821669202258386936f.example: The subordination was taught in the meeting: whoever spoke second was corrected first.

search-ddc9e669194254cef019a29d3619a2c16.definition: A setting that stops the machine starting until you hold the lock button for a few seconds.
search-ddc9e669194254cef019a29d3619a2c16.example: Hold the padlock button for three seconds to release the child lock.

search-dddebd3c7beb93513771f666431a6b0d4.definition: The weight a loss carries compared with a gain of the same size.
search-dddebd3c7beb93513771f666431a6b0d4.example: The same 20,000 hurt as a loss and helped as a saving.

search-dddebd3c7beb93513771f666431a6b0d4.definition: A strong dislike that turns a possible approach into an immediate withdrawal.
search-dddebd3c7beb93513771f666431a6b0d4.example: Her aversion to that kind of meeting turned into a refusal before she had read the message.

search-dde9330691e9eecd935aae6771612c300.definition: A device that compares the current going out with the current coming back, and opens the circuit when they differ.
search-dde9330691e9eecd935aae6771612c300.example: The residual-current device is the wide switch on the board with the test button.

search-ddf3c8a26e7de6359dfda8e24dd6ca9be.definition: To deal with something in a particular way.
Something you want very much and keep safe. It can be gold, but it can also be a letter or a photograph.
search-ddf3c8a26e7de6359dfda8e24dd6ca9be.example: The box in the grass held the real treasure.

search-ddfa615d0291fb0a7e7b2913d80c91d05.definition: The sense a person has of their own gender.
search-ddfa615d0291fb0a7e7b2913d80c91d05.example: Her gender identity was hers to say, and nobody in the room had a vote on it.

search-de01349e5fd87389f54ea6d3cdd36562b.definition: The short space in which one argument is weighed against another.
search-de01349e5fd87389f54ea6d3cdd36562b.example: Deliberation took two minutes, and the two minutes were enough.

search-de069eecdd84d3d48c44fa4c487e2636c.definition: The transition before menopause, when the cycles often change.
search-de069eecdd84d3d48c44fa4c487e2636c.example: She was in perimenopause, and her cycles had changed for a while.

search-de0d979d827d6b6926da10701c483c36b.definition: The ongoing work of keeping software alive: fixing, adapting, and explaining it across years of changing conditions.
How easily software can be understood, fixed and extended by a human in the future.
The work a person does to keep their place and their standing in a group.
search-de0d979d827d6b6926da10701c483c36b.example: Status maintenance is why she read the report twice before she sent it.

search-de1a43dcae4f8da0a3cef3c1699bc45b1.definition: A game with many pieces. You fit the pieces together to make a picture.
search-de1a43dcae4f8da0a3cef3c1699bc45b1.example: I finished the puzzle before dinner.

search-de2dc33e1c931c59e0007b709d2c3e179.definition: A tiny helper in food that keeps your body working well. Fruit has plenty of vitamins.
search-de2dc33e1c931c59e0007b709d2c3e179.example: One orange gives me lots of vitamin C.

search-de3336300b1cc6fce82451f858b12af15.definition: The gradual loss of a skill when it is no longer practiced because a machine performs it instead.

search-de39a191ba0c0fc669a54d46b1ed74f60.definition: When liquid water warms up, turns into vapour, and rises into the air.
search-de39a191ba0c0fc669a54d46b1ed74f60.example: Evaporation dried the wet clothes on the line.

search-de481aa7098b4396c0cf4cd88ef47a998.definition: Judging another culture by the standards of your own, and reading every difference as a mistake.
search-de481aa7098b4396c0cf4cd88ef47a998.example: Calling a local custom rude is ethnocentrism, not an observation.

search-de5aa2bf041d2678bfbcc29f8e3db904c.definition: The routes along which orders, reports and supplies travel to the fighting units.
search-de5aa2bf041d2678bfbcc29f8e3db904c.example: The lines of communication were cut by the flood.

search-de790defb8525b43fb46bfcd1ae09e4d5.definition: The part of the previous task still in your head after you stop it, which lowers the quality of the next task.
search-de790defb8525b43fb46bfcd1ae09e4d5.example: I checked messages between every paragraph, so both pieces of work suffered.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: The individual version of a language: one speaker's own habits of words and grammar.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: Every email you write becomes part of your idiolect.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: The average daily amount of energy or a nutrient for an adult. A guide, not a target.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: The reference intake for energy is about 2000 kilocalories a day.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: Difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep or waking too early, together with daytime impairment. The daytime effect is part of the definition.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: It is not just that I sleep badly; it is that I cannot work properly the next day. That makes it insomnia.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: To keep eggs warm so that the chicks inside can grow. The parent bird does it by sitting on them.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: The mother bird is incubating her eggs.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: A question asking if you are allowed to have something. The person can answer yes or no.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: Can I have a piece of bread?

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: A softer way to ask, good for when you talk to somebody you do not know well.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: Could I have the menu, please?

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: A warm way to say what you want. It is like saying I want, but kinder.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: I would like some orange juice, please.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: To say your name to somebody for the first time. It only means saying your name.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: I introduced myself and said, I am An.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: To start playing with a group that is already playing. You ask first, and then you join in.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: Can I join in your game?

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: A careful, grown-up way to ask for something. People listen more when you use it.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: May I sit here, please?

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: The percentage change in the general level of prices over a period of time, usually a year.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: The annual inflation rate was 4 %, so prices rose 4 % on average.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: The standard index of the price of a basket of goods and services bought by households. Its change over time is the headline inflation rate.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: The consumer price index is the number the news report quotes.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: Income measured in the money actually received, with no adjustment for changes in prices.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: My nominal income rose, but not as fast as prices.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: Income adjusted for inflation, which is the figure that says how much you can actually buy.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: Real income fell two per cent because prices rose faster than my pay.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: The interest rate minus the inflation rate. It is the return a saver actually keeps in purchasing power.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: A 4 % deposit with 6 % inflation gives a real interest rate of minus 2 %.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: The compulsory payment into the social insurance system that covers sickness, maternity, accidents and retirement.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: My social insurance contribution is a percentage of my gross pay.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: The moment you take the room, normally from 14:00 or 15:00. Before it, the hotel usually stores your luggage free of charge.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: Check-in is from 14:00, but I can leave my bags with you in the morning.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: Agreement and active support for a plan from the people who must carry it out.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: I spent two weeks getting buy-in from the regional teams.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: Being cut off from other people without choosing it, and without the comfort that solitude brings.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: Working from home every day turned into isolation by February.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: The material around the live part of a cable that keeps the current inside it.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: The insulation on the cable is cracked where it passes over the edge of the pit.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: The IP code on the nameplate that says how well the casing keeps out solid objects and water.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: The nameplate of this pump carries an ingress protection rating of IP68.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: The substance in the medicine that produces the effect. Every other substance in the pack is only there to help it.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: The active ingredient is the same in both packs, only the strength differs.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: What happens when a medicine meets another medicine, or alcohol, or a particular food. Some are dangerous.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: There is an interaction with this antibiotic, so I will tell the pharmacist about everything I take.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: A green climbing plant that grows up walls and trees. It holds on tightly and hides what is behind it.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: Ivy grew across the green door.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: An animal with six legs and a body in three parts: head, thorax and abdomen.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: An ant is an insect because it has six legs.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: The words you use to tell somebody your own name.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: My name is Lan, and I am seven.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: To ask somebody to join you, and to accept it when they say no.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: I invited him to sit with us.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: To make room for somebody in the group, the game or the talk.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: We included the new boy in our game.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: A design in which a person reviews and approves an agent's work before it takes effect.
A user interface that changes according to context, intent and history rather than showing fixed menus.
A statement of what the user wants to achieve, as opposed to the commands that achieve it.
The preference for rewards that arrive immediately over larger rewards that require waiting and effort.
The false feeling of understanding a topic that comes from easy access to answers rather than from real comprehension.
The habit of holding your own beliefs with the right amount of confidence: strong when the evidence is strong, weak when it is weak.
The skill of finding, judging and using information: telling a primary source from an opinion, and evidence from an anecdote.
The false feeling of competence that comes from producing results with powerful tools rather than from owned ability.
The state in which incoming information exceeds the capacity to process it, so each new item reduces the value of the ones before it.
A sudden push to act before you have thought it through.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: The impulse to reply at once was stronger than the answer.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: The ability to reason, to solve a problem that is not written down, and to adapt when the situation changes.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: Intelligence is what lets her find her way through a procedure she has never seen before.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: Running a trained model to produce one answer. Cheap and fast compared with training, and it is what happens when you press send.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: Training cost a fortune; inference is what you pay for every time you use it.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: The chips, data centers and energy supply that make training and running large models possible.
The condition in which switching suppliers is so costly that dependence continues regardless of price or quality.
A small, easy agreement that is used later as the reason for a much larger one.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: The free trial was the foot in the door: the yearly contract came next.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: Being cut off from other people without choosing it, and without the comfort that solitude brings.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: Working from home every day turned into isolation by February.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: Pressure strong enough to take away a person's freedom to decide, in the sense used in law and in medical consent.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: The form said the signature was voluntary; the manager's tone made that undue influence.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: The meaning a reader gives a result in their own work once they have understood it.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: The interpretation is the last step: the number is correct, and now it has to mean something on the night shift.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: The ability to form, hold and explain your own views without needing them to be pre-approved by an authority or a tool.
The obligation to stand behind one's beliefs and claims: to have checked them and to correct them when wrong.
A tax that is already counted inside the price you read.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: The ticket at 11 $ includes 1 $ of tax in the price, and the receipt does not show it separately.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: The price of borrowing money, charged as a percentage of what you still owe.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: At 2 % a year on a debt of 1 000 $, the interest for the year is 20 $.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: Running a trained model to produce one answer. Cheap and fast compared with training, and it is what happens when you press send.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: Training cost a fortune; inference is what you pay for every time you use it.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: The tokens you send, counted and billed on the way in. Documents and chat history both count here.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: Uploading the same file twice charges the input tokens twice.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: A policy that covers things like medical care, cancellation, lost documents and the cost of an emergency replacement passport.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: My travel insurance covers the emergency document and two extra hotel nights.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: A task that a named person has agreed to do. In longer emails these are listed explicitly.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: There are two action items: sending the figures and confirming the date.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: An interview with several interviewers at once, often one from each department of the company.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: It was a panel interview, so I introduced myself briefly at the start.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: A small, easy agreement that is used later as the reason for a much larger one.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: The free trial was the foot in the door: the yearly contract came next.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: A large request made first, so that the smaller request looks reasonable.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: The full package at 200,000 was the door in the face, and the single machine was the real order.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: The leaning towards acting before you have looked at what the act will do.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: The message went out in impatience, and the impulsivity cost him the job.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: Being single because the wish for a partner has not been met, rather than by choice.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: She calls it involuntary singleness, and she has stopped apologising for it.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: Power that belongs to an office or an organisation rather than to a person, and passes on with the role.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: Institutional power is why the badge opens the door even though the badge is not the man.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: Any effect one person has on another, from a request to advice, in either direction.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: Influence is not a privilege: the newest member of the team influences the oldest one as well.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: The sense a person has of their own gender.
search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.example: Her gender identity was hers to say, and nobody in the room had a vote on it.

search-de7d1b721a1e0632b7cf04edf5032c8ec.definition: Being cut off from other people without choosing it, and without the comfort that solitude brings.

search-ff84fd712f033944feaa5e3d0a1328a57.example: The box in the grass held the real treasure.

search-ff88bf24065193426262583a7d636aebc.definition: The arrangement of roles that says who decides and who answers for the decision.
search-ff88bf24065193426262583a7d636aebc.example: The hierarchy is clear on paper; the account, the invoice and the parts were not.

search-ffb431dcb40895014322ee75368fa37ce.definition: The condition that the reasons for a decision are visible and can be checked by the people affected.
search-ffb431dcb40895014322ee75368fa37ce.example: Transparency was missing: nobody could say which number the decision was based on.

search-ffc8b9d1b5fe723dad3653676605078a6.definition: The ability to use what you learned in one situation in a different situation.
search-ffc8b9d1b5fe723dad3653676605078a6.example: The training transferred well: the same method worked on a new line.

search-ffc8b9d1b5fe723dad3653676605078a6.definition: The continuous practice of building and refreshing one's knowledge and skills throughout life.
The method of letting a system find patterns in data instead of following instructions a person wrote for every case.
search-ffc8b9d1b5fe723dad3653676605078a6.example: Spam filtering was one of the first everyday uses of machine learning.

search-ffd3d21b48469c85982c1f15a1d7ef2ba.definition: The feeling you get when your body wants food and needs energy.
search-ffd3d21b48469c85982c1f15a1d7ef2ba.example: I am hungry, so I will have some bread.

search-ffd3d21b48469c85982c1f15a1d7ef2ba.definition: A design in which a person reviews and approves an agent's work before it takes effect.
The habit of holding your own beliefs with the right amount of confidence: strong when the evidence is strong, weak when it is weak.
The power to act deliberately and be responsible for one's actions, as opposed to reacting or being acted upon.

search-ffdb6efb7d3cceeb1c7cef0e4906c0c61.definition: The resting stage, when the insect changes its body. A butterfly's pupa is a chrysalis.
search-ffdb6efb7d3cceeb1c7cef0e4906c0c61.example: Inside the pupa, the caterpillar becomes a butterfly.

search-ffe2d77f8f34dd3e382569c525bb85485.definition: Coarse salt that softens the water in a dishwasher so that detergent can work. It goes in the round cap at the bottom of the tub.
search-ffe2d77f8f34dd3e382569c525bb85485.example: The salt symbol has come on, so I am filling the salt cap.

search-ffe8097ba79b07f751482c92ac443459d.definition: The act of lowering the value that other people attach to a person's work or judgement.
search-ffe8097ba79b07f751482c92ac443459d.example: The devaluation was quiet: every meeting began with a small doubt about her work.

search-ffe8097ba79b07f751482c92ac443459d.example: The devaluation was quiet: every meeting began with a small doubt about her work.

search-ffefe686c3dd9a5857f7f531791bb34ee.definition: Means held back from the first effort and kept for the moment the situation turns.
search-ffefe686c3dd9a5857f7f531791bb34ee.example: The plan kept one reserve for the second week.

search-ffefe686c3dd9a5857f7f531791bb34ee.definition: An estimate of how many eggs remain in the ovaries, built from hormone measurements and sometimes a scan.
search-ffefe686c3dd9a5857f7f531791bb34ee.example: The ovarian reserve estimate describes a stock; it is not a statement about the odds.

search-fff54f2073829bb9f53e03f1a660ac1b9.definition: When one person's behaviour and words point in different directions, usually because they are unsure or unwilling to say where things stand.
search-fff54f2073829bb9f53e03f1a660ac1b9.example: He texts every day but has cancelled three plans — those are mixed signals.

search-fff54f2073829bb9f53e03f1a660ac1b9.definition: The proportion of useful information (signal) to everything else (noise) in a stream of content.
